# `revision` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/revision.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

One managed project revision (doc 03 §18, rank 60, `revisions.jsonl`; FR-REV-001).

The title block's "Revision" cell prints the current revision: the open one if there is one, else the
latest released one (D-05, FR-REV-003). A released revision is immutable (FR-REV-009); one without a
release record is historic (released outside EW, so it has no as-built archive and no page digests).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `revision` |
| File | `revisions.jsonl` |
| Rank | 60 |
| Status | implemented |
| Record version | 1 |
| Schema | [`revision.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/schemas/0.1/revision.schema.json) |

## Types

### Date

An authored date YYYY-MM-DD (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (pattern `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`)

Pattern: `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### MlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### PageNote

One page a revision declares as changed (FR-REV-012).

`page` is not a link (`ew-model` lists it among the fields that are not links): a released revision
is immutable, so its notes keep naming a page that a later revision deletes, and a note on a page that
does not exist selects nothing.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | [`MlText`](#mltext) | no |  | What changed on the page. |
| `page` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The page. |

### PartyRole

The role of a `Party`.

| Value | Meaning |

| `"customer"` | Customer. |
| `"end_user"` | End user. |
| `"panel_builder"` | Panel builder (legal owner of the drawings). |
| `"author"` | Author. |
| `"checker"` | Checker. |
| `"engineer"` | Engineer. |

### ReleaseRecord

The release record of a revision released by ElektraWatt (doc 03 §18; FR-REV-006, FR-REV-020, FR-REV-022),
written in the same atomic step as the as-built archive (doc 05 §14.1).

Every member is optional, so a partial record written while the member was untyped loads and writes back as
it is; members in byte order of their names, the order of the untyped form.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `approval` | [`SignOff`](#signoff) or `null` | no |  | The sign-off, copied at release (FR-REV-020). |
| `archive` | [`ArchiveRef`](#archiveref) or `null` | no |  | The as-built archive (ADR-0013). |
| `changed_pages` | array of [`Uuid`](#uuid) or `null` | no |  | The pages the release changed, in page order (frozen; doc 15 §5.6). Not links: a released revision is immutable, so it keeps naming a page that a later revision deletes. |
| `content_digest` | [`Sha256`](#sha256) or `null` | no |  | The content digest at the released generation, after the freeze. |
| `derivation_profile` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | The derivation profile of the release. |
| `generation` | integer (format `uint64`, min 0) or `null` | no |  | The released generation. |
| `git_tag` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | The git tag `ew/rev/<label>`, when the project is a git repository. |
| `page_digests` | map of [`Digest128`](#digest128) or `null` | no |  | The digest of every page at the release, by page ID (doc 15 §5.6; WP-S1.18 D6). The keys are not links. |
| `released_on` | [`Date`](#date) or `null` | no |  | The release date. |
| `rule_packs` | array of [`PackVersion`](#packversion) or `null` | no |  | The rule packs of the gate's run. |

### ArchiveRef

The as-built archive of a release: its file name and its SHA-256 (ADR-0013, doc 05 §14.2). Every member is
optional; members in byte order of their names.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string or `null` | no |  | The file name, `<label>.ewarchive`. |
| `sha256` | [`Sha256`](#sha256) or `null` | no |  | The SHA-256 of the archive file. |

### Digest128

A 128-bit digest as 32 lower-case hexadecimal digits (a page digest, doc 15 §5.6).

Type: string (pattern `^[0-9a-f]{32}$`)

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{32}$`

### PackVersion

One rule pack of a check run: its ID, its version and the SHA-256 of its definition (doc 15 §3.9). Every
member is optional; members in byte order of their names.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | The pack ID (`EW-CORE`). |
| `sha256` | [`Sha256`](#sha256) or `null` | no |  | The SHA-256 of the pack's definition. |
| `version` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | The pack version. |

### RevisionState

The stored state of a revision (doc 03 §4.2, doc 15 §5.1). "Signed off" is not a state: it is an open
revision whose sign-off matches the current content digest.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"open"` | The revision that collects the current edits; at most one (EW-INV-016). |
| `"released"` | Released: by `revision.release`, or historic (released before the project came to EW). Immutable. |
| `"withdrawn"` | A withdrawal record: it names the released revision it withdraws (`withdraws`, FR-REV-009). |

### Sha256

A SHA-256 digest sha256:&lt;64 lower-case hex> (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (pattern `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)

Pattern: `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`

### SignOff

The checker's sign-off on the open revision (doc 15 §5.4, FR-REV-005, FR-REV-021), written by
`revision.approve` and copied into `ReleaseRecord::approval` at release (FR-REV-020).

Every member is optional, so a partial sign-off written while the member was untyped loads and writes back
as it is; the release gate (EW-REL-001) judges whether it is complete and matches the current content
digest. Members in byte order of their names, the order of the untyped form.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `checker` | [`PartyRole`](#partyrole) or `null` | no |  | The checker, as the role of a project party; never the revision's author (D-34). |
| `content_digest` | [`Sha256`](#sha256) or `null` | no |  | The content digest the checker approved: SHA-256 over the sorted `(path, sha256)` entries of the saved manifest, without `revisions.jsonl` and `comments.jsonl` (doc 15 §5.4). |
| `date` | [`Date`](#date) or `null` | no |  | The date of the approval. |
| `packs` | array of [`PackVersion`](#packversion) or `null` | no |  | The rule packs of the release-mode run the checker saw. |
| `scheme` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | The check scheme of that run (`pre-delivery`). |
| `waivers_ack` | array of [`Uuid`](#uuid) or `null` | no |  | The waivers of safety-kind rules the checker acknowledged, by ID. Not links: a sign-off is history, and a waiver change voids it anyway (`waivers.jsonl` is in the content digest). |

### SourceRef

The import provenance of a record (doc 14 §2.3, ADR-0004 amendment 1): the lineage and the source key
from which the record's ID `v5(lineage namespace, key)` was derived.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |  | The source key, byte for byte (NFC), such as `qet:el:<uuid>`. |
| `lineage` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The import lineage. |

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`
